steps.action: Opened api.slack.com/apps in the project browser profile
steps.observation: The page asked to sign in to Slack. The account only listed two large community workspaces, so the owner created a new free workspace and signed in on the apps page again.

steps.action: Clicked Create an App, chose Blank app, named it oauthpath-test-20261029, picked the new workspace and confirmed
steps.observation: Templates on offer: AI agent, Starter app, From a manifest, Blank app. Four steps, no terms checkbox. Slack warned the app can't be installed without scopes; Create Anyway made it instantly.
Install is disabled until at least one scope is added. Bot and user token scopes are listed separately. Token rotation (needs a redirect URL) and PKCE are opt-in. No scope or redirect URL was added.

steps.action: Read the Basic Information page without clicking Show
steps.observation: Credentials exist from creation, before any install: the Client ID is visible; the Client Secret and Signing Secret are masked behind Show and Regenerate. No secret was revealed.

Activating public distribution first needs four steps: enable features, add OAuth redirect URLs, remove hard-coded information, use HTTPS. Activation was not attempted; no review step was shown there.

steps.action: Cleanup: the test app and the new workspace were not deleted during the session
steps.observation: The owner chose to delete them later. The app and workspace still exist until then; no secret was ever revealed, so none needs removing.

stoppedAt: before adding scopes or installing: guide steps 1, 2 and 4 were read, steps 3 and 5 to 9 were not attempted

corrections.docClaim: A Slack account to create the app and reach the App Management page, where the client ID is found.
corrections.observed: A Slack account is not enough: creating an app also needs a workspace, and the apps page asks for its own sign-in. A new free workspace worked. The Client ID is visible at once; the secrets stay masked behind Show.

corrections.docClaim: An access token appears under OAuth Tokens after you install the app.
corrections.observed: Install is disabled until a scope is added, and the Client ID and secrets exist from the moment the app is created, before any install.
